title.narrative: Strengthening Ethical Governance of AI and Digital Technologies

description.narrative:
This initiative aims to support Egypt in advancing ethical, human rights-based approaches to artificial intelligence and emerging digital technologies. It will promote awareness, knowledge exchange, and capacity development among policymakers, public institutions, academia, civil society, and private-sector stakeholders to foster the responsible design, deployment, and governance of digital technologies.
Building on UNESCO’s normative frameworks, including the Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, the initiative will contribute to strengthening national capacities to address the ethical, social, and governance implications of frontier technologies while promoting innovation that is inclusive, transparent, accountable, and aligned with human rights principles.
